emergency.condition_text: a sweeper is coming, and under Zur or Starfield of Nyx your enchantments are creatures that die to it
indications: A seat is holding four or more mana in white and has cast nothing on their turn
Starfield of Nyx is on the battlefield and you control five or more enchantments, so every other non-Aura enchantment you own is already a creature
You animated three or more enchantments on earlier turns and they are still creatures — Zur's ability has no duration
A sweeper has already resolved this game from a seat that plays more than one
Your hand is empty and your enchantment count is the whole board
immediate: Stop animating. Zur's {1}{W} lasts forever, so an enchantment you animate this turn is still a creature when the sweeper resolves.
Animate Heliod, Sun-Crowned, Thassa, God of the Sea and Athreos, God of Passage instead. All three are indestructible, and {1}{W} makes each a 3/3 whatever your devotion is.
Keep one enchantment in hand. The board you rebuild from is the card you did not commit.
If Academy Rector is on the battlefield, let the sweeper kill it and fetch Sphere of Safety onto the battlefield — it enters after the sweeper and taxes the crack-back.
If you hold Counterspell or No More Lies, spend it on the sweeper rather than on the ramp spell in front of it.
subsequent: Recast Zur before you animate anything. Without him the bodies are vanilla and every removal spell in the pod works again.
Rebuild to two threats, not five: the draw engine first, then one enchantment creature.
Return an enchantment from your graveyard on each upkeep with Starfield of Nyx.
Cast the drain that needs no combat step: Sanctum of Stone Fangs takes X in your first main phase, and Grim Guardian and Balemurk Leech each take 1 from every opponent whenever an enchantment enters.

Spend {1}{W} on Enduring Tenacity, Enduring Innocence and Enduring Curiosity after they come back. Each returns itself to the battlefield as an enchantment when it dies as a creature, and animation makes it a body again.
emergency.notes: Zur's ability sets base power and toughness, so it shrinks as well as grows. Heliod and Thassa are 5/5 and Athreos is 5/4 once devotion turns them on; animate one then and you have a 3/3. Animate a God while your devotion is short, not after.

emergency.condition_text: a removal spell is on the stack, aimed at Zur or at an enchantment you have not animated
indications: The target is an enchantment you have not animated — Rhystic Study, Phyrexian Arena and Sphere of Safety carry no hexproof until they are creatures
The target is Zur himself: a 1/4 with flying and no hexproof of his own
A seat passes on your animated bodies and points removal at Zur
The spell is enchantment removal rather than creature removal
You have less than two mana untapped and one of it is not white
immediate: Animate the targeted enchantment with {1}{W} in response. It becomes an enchantment creature, Zur grants it hexproof, and the spell has no legal target left.
If Zur is the target, counter the spell. The deck holds Counterspell {U}{U} and No More Lies {W}{U}; Muddle the Mixture counters an instant or a sorcery only.
If the target is Academy Rector and the spell destroys rather than exiles, let it resolve. The death trigger fetches any enchantment onto the battlefield with no mana-value limit.
If Zur dies, animate nothing else this turn. {1}{W} without him buys a vanilla body that the next removal spell kills.
Recast Zur on the first turn you can also hold {1}{W} open.
subsequent: Hold {1}{W} through every opponent's turn. Each two mana you keep is one removal spell you can blank.
Put Sheltered by Ghosts on an enchantment creature rather than on Zur — hexproof stops the pod removing the body to break the Aura, and your own Aura can still target it.
Animate the enchantments whose text the deck runs on — Rhystic Study, Phyrexian Arena, Black Market Connections — before you animate the ones you only want for power.
Cast Enlightened Tutor for Sphere of Safety in an opponent's end step when the pod is spending removal one card at a time; it goes on top of your library and you draw it next turn.
emergency.notes: Hexproof stops opponents only. Zur's own {1}{W}, Sheltered by Ghosts, Heliod's counter and Eidolon of Astral Winds all still target your own enchantment creatures.

emergency.condition_text: a seat is assembling a two-card line and you are the seat holding blue mana
indications: A seat has passed with two or more blue sources untapped for two turns
A tutor resolved and the card went to hand rather than to the battlefield
A commander that is a known combo piece has just been recast
Rhystic Study or Mystic Remora drew you a card off a spell that made no board
A seat is drawing three or more cards a turn and has stopped attacking
immediate: Counter the piece that comes out of the library, not the ritual in front of it. Counterspell {U}{U} and No More Lies {W}{U} stop any spell; Muddle the Mixture {U}{U} stops an instant or a sorcery.
If the line runs through a creature, exile it: Swords to Plowshares {W}, Path to Exile {W}, Sheltered by Ghosts {1}{W} or Ossification {1}{W}.

If the line runs through an opponent's commander, cast Imprisoned in the Moon on it. It becomes a colourless land with no abilities and stays on the battlefield, so it is not recast from the command zone.
If the line runs through a graveyard, exile the card with Summoner's Sending in your end step.
If you hold no answer, count your own lethal before you pass: animate everything, attack, and point Enduring Tenacity at the combo seat.
subsequent: Transmute Muddle the Mixture for {1}{U}{U} on your own turn to fetch a mana-value-2 card to hand — The Meathook Massacre and Journey to Nowhere are both in range.
Hold Counterspell over casting a fourth enchantment on the turn the combo seat untaps.
Cast Rhystic Study before the combo seat's turn and make them pay {1} on every piece.
Tell the table which card you are holding up. A pod that knows the counterspell exists spends a turn playing around it, and a turn is what this deck needs.
emergency.notes: This deck contains no two-card infinite line of its own — deck-facts reports zero contained combos and zero two-card infinites in the 99, and a test enforces it. Say so at the table; it is true, and it is why the pod should be pointing its answers elsewhere.

emergency.condition_text: the land drops have stopped, or the colour you need is the one you do not have
indications: You have missed a land drop — the model misses one by turn five in 41% of games, and its land-drop hit rate falls to 0.64 by turn ten (diagnostic.json, 10,000 seeded iterations)
You hold a double-black card — Enduring Tenacity {2}{B}{B}, Nighthowler {1}{B}{B}, Phyrexian Arena {1}{B}{B} — and one black source
You hold Zur and are missing one of {W}, {U} or {B}
Darkwater Catacombs or Talon Gates of Madara is your only source of a colour
You have five or more cards in hand and cast one spell last turn
immediate: Play the painland untapped and pay the life. Caves of Koilos, City of Brass, Mana Confluence, Underground River and Spire of Industry each cost 1 life a tap, and lifelink pays it back.
Crack Field of Ruin for {2}: destroy an opponent's nonbasic and search a basic onto the battlefield in the colour you are short.

If Land Tax is on the battlefield and any opponent controls more lands than you, take three basics and choose for the colour you are short — six Swamps, three Plains and three Islands are in the deck.
Cast the rock before the enchantment: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Talisman of Dominance.
Spend down to {1}{W} rather than to zero. One animation is the cheapest body this deck makes.
subsequent: Cast Enlightened Tutor {W} for Land Tax or Mystic Remora rather than for a payoff you cannot cast; it puts the card on top, so cast it in an opponent's end step.

Hold the double-black cards until you control two black sources. Black is the tight colour: 27 land sources against the 36 a 90% on-curve rate would take, and 0.718 on curve for a double-black cost once the two gated lands are excluded (mana_analysis.json).
Cast Black Market Connections and take Sell Contraband every turn until the land drops resume.
Play Urza's Saga and take chapter III for Sol Ring when it is still in the library.
emergency.notes: Darkwater Catacombs and Talon Gates of Madara are counted as sources of three colours each and cannot pay a coloured cost on curve: both charge extra mana on top of the tap (mana_analysis.json, sources.gated).

emergency.condition_text: it is turn six or later, Zur is not on the battlefield, and the enchantments you control are doing nothing but sitting there
indications: Turn six or later and Zur has not resolved
You control four or fewer enchantments, so Starfield of Nyx would animate nothing worth animating
You are drawing one card a turn: none of Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Phyrexian Arena, Black Market Connections, Entity Tracker or Enduring Curiosity is on the battlefield
Your board is enchantments you have never animated
You have passed two turns without attacking
immediate: Cast Zur ahead of anything else that costs three. Zur and Starfield of Nyx are the two cards that turn an enchantment you control into a body, and Starfield needs five enchantments on the battlefield first.
Animate the largest non-Aura enchantment you control. Power equals mana value, so Sphere of Safety and Cathars' Crusade are 5/5s and Rhystic Study is a 3/3.
Cast the draw engine ahead of the payoff. The model reaches a draw engine that keeps drawing by turn three in 68% of games, and names it the bottleneck (diagnostic.json).
Cast Academy Rector and put it in front of the largest attacker. You want it to die: it fetches any enchantment onto the battlefield with no mana-value limit.
Take Starfield of Nyx with Demonic Tutor once you control four enchantments. From the fifth onward it animates every other non-Aura enchantment for no mana.
subsequent: Count your enchantments at the start of every turn and say the number out loud. Five is the line Starfield of Nyx turns on at.
Cast the expensive enchantment over the cheap one when both are castable and you intend to attack.
Hard-cast Bitterblossom, Dawn of Hope and Felidar Retreat to put bodies on the board while the enchantment count climbs.
Fetch to the battlefield with Academy Rector rather than to hand with Enlightened Tutor when you are behind on board.
emergency.notes: Zur the Enchanter is a card in the 99 now, not the command zone. His attack trigger still fetches an enchantment of mana value 3 or less when he is on the battlefield, but he costs four and he is not the plan — do not build a turn around attacking with him.

emergency.condition_text: the pod has decided you are the problem, and the removal is coming to your seat
indications: Two seats have named Rhystic Study or Sphere of Safety out loud
Removal is being pointed at Zur rather than at anything on your board
A seat has stopped attacking you and is holding cards
Your drain triggers have taken one opponent below 20 while the others are near 40
Nobody has attacked the seat with the largest board for two turns
immediate: Spread the drain. Enduring Tenacity and Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose each pick a target per trigger, so take the two lowest totals down together rather than one to zero.

Spend your next removal spell on somebody else's threat and name the seat before you cast it — Swords to Plowshares, Path to Exile, Journey to Nowhere, Ossification and Sheltered by Ghosts all read as help.
Cast Sphere of Safety. Each attacker must pay {X} for your enchantment count, so a table that has decided to kill you pays for it three times over.
Animate only what you need to block. A standing animated board reads as a threat every turn; {1}{W} on an opponent's turn makes the same deathtouch blocker and shows nothing until it is needed.
Tap Forbidden Orchard last and name the seat with the fewest attackers — every tap hands a named opponent a 1/1 Spirit.
subsequent: Hold Starfield of Nyx until the turn you attack with what it animates.
Take Sell Contraband on Black Market Connections rather than Hire a Mercenary while you are the target; a Treasure is quiet and a 3/2 body that costs you 3 life is not.
Recast the drain payoff after the pod has moved on to another seat.
Stop reminding the table about Rhystic Study once they are paying {1} every time. A tax the pod has learned is still a tax.
emergency.notes: Deathtouch changes the arithmetic of a block, not its optics. An animated 3/3 Rhystic Study kills whatever it blocks, and the pod prices it as a 3/3 until the first time it does.

emergency.condition_text: a seat is faster than you and your board will not stop it on the ground
indications: A seat is attacking for eight or more a turn and you are not blocking profitably
Your life total is below 25 and you have paid for lands, Bitterblossom, Phyrexian Arena and Black Market Connections
You control no lifelink body: Zur has not resolved, or every enchantment creature you own is still in hand
Sphere of Safety is in the library and you control fewer than eight enchantments
The racing seat has more power on the battlefield than you and untaps first
immediate: Animate a blocker at instant speed. {1}{W} on any non-Aura enchantment during their turn makes a deathtouch body they did not declare around.
Block with it. Deathtouch makes the trade theirs to lose, and lifelink turns the damage it deals into life.
Cast Sphere of Safety. Animating an enchantment does not remove it from Sphere's count — it is a creature in addition to its other types — so the tax holds while you make blockers.
Turn the block into a drain: with Enduring Tenacity or Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose on the battlefield, the life you gain comes off the racing seat's total.
Cast The Meathook Massacre with X large enough to clear their board. Every creature you lose to it drains each opponent for 1.
subsequent: Chump-block with Academy Rector and fetch Sphere of Safety onto the battlefield off the death trigger.
Cast Bitterblossom and chump with a flying Faerie every upkeep.
Gain life back with Honden of Cleansing Fire, Underworld Coinsmith and Daxos, Blessed by the Sun, and stop paying life for lands the turn you go below 15.
Race back rather than stabilise once your board power passes theirs; the model puts board power at 22.09 by turn ten with combat modelled (goldfish_metrics.json, 10,000 seeded games).
emergency.notes: The Enduring cycle pays for a chump block. Enduring Tenacity, Enduring Innocence and Enduring Curiosity each return to the battlefield as an enchantment when they die as a creature, and {1}{W} makes one a creature again — the body is spent, the text is not.

keep: Three lands with a white source among them: {1}{W} is the animation cost, and white carries 42 pips across 36 cards (mana_analysis.json)
Two lands plus Sol Ring, Arcane Signet or Talisman of Dominance
{W}, {U} and {B} all reachable by turn three, so Zur is castable on curve
A play on turn one or turn two: Land Tax, Mystic Remora, Hypnotic Siren, Sol Ring, Bitterblossom, Northern Air Temple, Sanctum of Stone Fangs, Daxos, Blessed by the Sun or Inquisitive Glimmer
Two black sources if the hand holds two or more black cards — black is the tight colour at 27 land sources
ship: One land, whatever else is in it
No white source with three or more white cards
Five lands and two spells that both cost four or more
Zur plus five cards that all cost four or more
preflight.note: Gemstone Caverns is a land you have already played when you are not the starting player: begin the game with it on the battlefield with a luck counter and exile a card from your hand. Count it as a land, and as any colour, before you decide.

steps: Play the land that makes black first when the hand holds a black two-drop. Black is the tight colour: 27 land sources against the 36 a 90% on-curve rate would take.
Turn one, cast Land Tax, Mystic Remora, Hypnotic Siren or Sol Ring, in that order of preference.
Turn two, cast the two-mana enchantment that draws or drains over the one that makes a body: Dawn of Hope, Sanctum of Stone Fangs, Bitterblossom, Journey to Nowhere.
Turn three, cast Zur when you already control two or more enchantments. Otherwise cast the three-mana draw engine and cast Zur on turn four.
Pay Mystic Remora's cumulative upkeep while it costs {1} or {2}. Let it go the turn it costs {3}.
startup.note: This deck pays life to run: five lands cost 1 life a tap and the three shocklands cost 2 on entry, and Bitterblossom, Phyrexian Arena and Black Market Connections each bill you every turn. Lifelink is what pays it back, so every point you spend before Zur lands is spent on credit.

steps: Land a draw engine first: Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Phyrexian Arena, Black Market Connections, Entity Tracker, Tocasia's Welcome or Caretaker's Talent.
Cast Zur second. Until he is on the battlefield the 16 enchantment creatures in the 99 are plain bodies with no deathtouch, no lifelink and no hexproof.
Cast a drain payoff third — Enduring Tenacity, Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose or Marauding Blight-Priest — so that lifelinked combat damage takes life off a named opponent as well.
Count to five enchantments, then cast Starfield of Nyx. From the fifth onward every other non-Aura enchantment you control is a creature with power equal to its mana value, for no mana.
Cast Academy Rector last and put it where it dies. It fetches any enchantment onto the battlefield with no mana-value limit; Starfield of Nyx and Sphere of Safety are the two that change a board.
assembly.note: Mana value is a virtue here, not a cost. Power equals mana value under both Zur and Starfield of Nyx, so the five-drop is the 5/5 and the one-drop is the 1/1. Cast the expensive enchantment over the cheap one whenever both fit and you intend to attack.

steps: Upkeep: pay Mystic Remora or let it go, then return an enchantment from your graveyard with Starfield of Nyx.
Make the land drop. Take the painland untapped over the tapland; lifelink gives the life back.
Count your enchantments. Below five, cast the cheapest enchantment that raises the count. At five or more with Starfield of Nyx out, cast the most expensive one you can afford.
Before declaring attackers, spend {1}{W} per animation, largest mana value first.

Attack with every enchantment creature. Deathtouch makes each block a trade the opponent loses; lifelink turns the damage that connects into a drain through Enduring Tenacity or Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose.
Pass with {1}{W} open. Animation has no timing restriction, so it makes a deathtouch blocker on an opponent's turn.
cruise.note: Never animate Urza's Saga: its mana value is 0, so it becomes a 0/0 and dies on the spot. Starfield of Nyx does it for you — it animates each other non-Aura enchantment you control, the Saga included — so resolve Starfield only after the Saga has taken chapter III, or accept losing it.

steps: Total the mana values of every non-Aura enchantment you can afford to animate, and add the power already on the battlefield.
Add the drain. With Enduring Tenacity or Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose on the battlefield, every point of lifelinked damage that connects is a matching point off one opponent you name.
Animate everything you intend to attack with before you declare attackers. A body animated after blockers cannot attack.
Name a target for each trigger. Enduring Tenacity and Vito pick an opponent per lifegain event, so split the drain across two seats or focus one.
Wait a turn when Sphere of Safety is not on the battlefield and the crack-back is lethal.
closing.note: Every speed figure in this book is the goldfish's: 10,000 seeded games against one opponent at 40 life who does not block and does not remove. It is the model's clock, not an expectation, and its combat figures have run 4-5x ahead of Forge on this deck. No Forge run exists for this commander at all — every simulated game on this list was played with Zur the Enchanter in the command zone.

optics: Zur, Eternal Schemer costs three and reads as an unanswerable board the moment the table reads hexproof. A pod that cannot target you reaches for a sweeper instead — play as though a wipe is in every hand from the turn he lands.
Rhystic Study taxes every opponent on every spell. Expect it named and expect it answered.
Sphere of Safety is public arithmetic: each attacker pays {X} for your enchantment count, and the table can count your enchantments.
Forbidden Orchard hands a named opponent a 1/1 Spirit on every tap. Tap it last.
Enduring Tenacity and Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose take life off an opponent you name every time you gain any. The seat you name is the seat that comes for you.
An animated Rhystic Study is a 3/3 that also draws you cards. The pod prices the body and forgets the text.
reveal: Cast the draw engine before the drain payoff. Rhystic Study and Phyrexian Arena read as value; Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose reads as a clock.
Hold Starfield of Nyx until the turn you can animate and attack. It costs nothing once you control five enchantments and it changes the whole board in one step.
Animate on an opponent's turn rather than in your own main phase while you are ahead. A body that appears during combat is a blocker; a body that stands there all round is a threat.
Cast Sphere of Safety the turn before you expect to be attacked, not the turn you can first afford it.
Keep the Enduring cycle's return trigger to yourself. A pod that has watched Enduring Tenacity come back once stops trading with it.
alliances: Say the deck runs no infinite combo. Deck-facts reports zero contained combos and zero two-card infinites in the 99, and a test enforces it.
Cast Swords to Plowshares or Path to Exile on the table's fastest board, on their turn, so the seat you helped sees it happen.
Point the drain at the seat with the most life and tell the table you are doing it.
Spend a counterspell on the spell that beats three seats before the one that beats you.
Offer Imprisoned in the Moon on the commander the whole table is afraid of; it stays on the battlefield as a land and never returns to the command zone.
targets: Attack the seat whose blockers are largest. Deathtouch means a bigger blocker trades for the same body a 1/1 would.
Leave the seat whose only interaction is targeted removal until last — hexproof blanks it, so that seat costs you the least while it is alive.
Kill the seat you have been draining. Enduring Tenacity and Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose have already done half the work on whoever you named.
Hit the seat holding the sweeper first when you control Starfield of Nyx; under it your enchantments die with your creatures.
Split attackers across two seats once your board power passes 15. Every lifelinked hit is a drain trigger, and each trigger picks its own opponent.
